title: OpenAI is not just replacing its revenue chief, it is rebuilding the sales operation
excerpt: Denise Dresser is out as OpenAI's chief revenue officer. Ex-Wiz president Dali Rajic replaces her, and OpenAI is rebuilding the sales team around him.
content_html:
OpenAI chief revenue officer Denise Dresser is leaving after eight months, replaced by Dali Rajic, formerly president and chief operating officer of Wiz. The company has also hired recruiters to rebuild its go-to-market team, two days after longtime executive Brad Lightcap said he was leaving.

OpenAI’s chief revenue officer is leaving after eight months in the job. Denise Dresser is departing “to pursue other opportunities,” the company said on Thursday, and will stay through a transition period working with the business team. Dali Rajic, formerly president and chief operating officer of Wiz, takes the role.

OpenAI was warm about what she built. It credits Dresser with assembling the team, strengthening relationships with major customers and establishing “the commercial foundation that has brought our business to this point.” She joined in December after more than a decade at Salesforce, where she had been named chief executive of Slack in 2023.

The timing is the problem. Brad Lightcap, who spent eight years at OpenAI and four of them as chief operating officer, left on Tuesday to start something new. Dresser makes the tenth senior departure since April.

That list already runs through chief product officer Kevin Weil, applications chief Fidji Simo, chief marketing officer Kate Rouch, Sora architect Bill Peebles, safety head Johannes Heidecke and AI ethics head Chloé Bakalar. Losing the person who owns the revenue number is a different order of problem.

The replacement suggests what OpenAI thinks it needs. Rajic ran Wiz as president and chief operating officer through the period Google agreed to buy it for $32bn, a deal that closed in March. Before that he was president and chief operating officer of Zscaler, and chief customer and revenue officer at AppDynamics.

OpenAI wants him to build what it calls a revenue operating system. President Greg Brockman said the company is “moving into a compute-powered economy, with AI becoming embedded in every workflow,” and that Rajic will “turn what we’ve learned into repeatable execution.”

The quieter line in the announcement says more. OpenAI has also formed a partnership with Chad Peets and RPT Partners, a firm that recruits sales leadership, to build what it describes as a world-class go-to-market team. Companies that are happy with their sales organisation do not hire people to rebuild it.

The business he inherits is large. OpenAI says its products reach more than a billion weekly users and more than two million businesses, twice as many companies as a year ago.

It is also about to be examined in public. OpenAI has filed confidentially for a listing and closed a $7bn employee tender offer valuing it at $852bn, though it has been reported to be weighing a delay to 2027 to hold out for $1tn.

OpenAI said it is “deeply grateful” for Dresser’s leadership. It has not said why she is going, and neither has she.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 首席营收官 Denise Dresser 在八个月后离职，由 Wiz 前总裁兼首席运营官 Dali Rajic 接替。 该公司还聘请了招聘人员来重建其上市团队，两天前，长期担任高管的布拉德·莱特卡普(Brad Lightcap)表示将离职。

OpenAI 首席营收官在上任八个月后即将离职。 该公司周四表示，丹尼斯·德莱瑟（Denise Dresser）将离职“以寻求其他机会”，并将在过渡期内与业务团队合作。 Wiz 前总裁兼首席运营官 Dali Rajic 接任这一职务。

OpenAI 对她所构建的东西很感兴趣。 它称赞德莱赛组建了团队，加强了与主要客户的关系，并建立了“使我们的业务发展到今天的商业基础”。 她于 12 月加入 Salesforce，此前她在 Salesforce 工作了十多年，并于 2023 年被任命为 Slack 首席执行官。

时机是问题。 Brad Lightcap 在 OpenAI 工作了八年，其中四年担任首席运营官，他于周二离开，开始了新的事业。 德莱瑟是自四月份以来第十位高管离职。

该名单已经涵盖了首席产品官 Kevin Weil、应用程序主管 Fidji Simo、首席营销官 Kate Rouch、Sora 架构师 Bill Peebles、安全主管 Johannes Heidecke 和 AI 道德主管 Chloé Bakalar。 失去拥有收入号码的人是另一个问题。

替代品表明了 OpenAI 认为它需要的内容。 在谷歌同意以 320 亿美元收购 Wiz 期间，拉吉克 (Rajic) 担任总裁兼首席运营官，这笔交易于 3 月份完成。 在此之前，他曾担任 Zscaler 的总裁兼首席运营官以及 AppDynamics 的首席客户和收入官。

OpenAI 希望他构建所谓的收益操作系统。 总裁 Greg Brockman 表示，该公司正在“进入计算驱动型经济，人工智能将嵌入到每个工作流程中”，而 Rajic 将“将我们学到的知识转化为可重复的执行”。

公告中较为安静的内容说明了更多信息。 OpenAI 还与 Chad Peets 和 RPT Partners（一家招聘销售领导力的公司）建立了合作伙伴关系，以建立其所谓的世界一流的上市团队。 对销售组织感到满意的公司不会雇用人员来重建它。

他继承的生意很大。 OpenAI 表示，其产品每周覆盖超过 10 亿用户和超过 200 万家企业，是一年前的两倍。

它还即将接受公开审查。 OpenAI 已秘密提交上市申请，并完成了 70 亿美元的员工要约收购，估值达 8520 亿美元，不过据报道，该公司正在考虑推迟到 2027 年，以坚持 1 万亿美元的收购要约。

OpenAI 表示对德莱瑟的领导“深表感谢”。 它没有说明她为什么要去，她也没有。
